snippet.title: Dead Hand Steam Next Fest Trailler - October 2026
snippet.description:
The Dead Hand demo is now live on Steam!
In a world ravaged by the zombie apocalypse, every card counts. They're both your actions… and your resources. To play is to consume. To survive is to choose.
Pick your survivor and try to last as long as you can.
🗓️ Join us at Steam Next Fest, October 19–26, and wishlist Dead Hand. It means the world to a solo dev 🙏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4631120/Dead_Hand
